blocking_findings: COLD-R02-B1 [procedure/runbook revision contradiction]: R02/PROCEDURE.md:52-53 (hash-bound literal procedure) mandates the first formal run with --config EXPERIMENTS/EXP-20260923-T1-STEP5-MICRO-R01/resolved/EXP-20260923-T1-STEP5-MICRO-R01-control-s7.leo-sim.yaml and --authorization EXPERIMENTS/EXP-20260923-T1-STEP5-MICRO-R01/authorization.json, i.e. the superseded R01 directories, while both R02 RUNBOOKs (:16-30), R02/artifact-set.json (all 17 entries are -R02 files) and brief.json context:47 state revision 2 runs under its own -R02 experiment ids. CODE/scripts/remote/run-remote.sh:97 derives run_id from the config file NAME, so following PROCEDURE.md literally would launch and attribute all four formal runs to the R01 experiments, never execute the R02 compiled artifacts, and make the R02 analysis-request planned_run_ids (EXP-...-R02-*) unreachable; no authorization.json exists in either revision's directories, so the reader must also generate one without the procedure saying for which experiment. COLD-R02-B2 [finalize/authorize handoff undocumented]: the mandated ordering compile -> three reviews -> finalization -> authorization -> clean deployment -> formal run -> recomputation is not achievable by following R02/PROCEDURE.md alone. The procedure names --authorization (:47-48, :53, :150) but gives no command to produce R02/finalization.json (declared as work_finalization by request.json:140/152, correctly absent pre-review) or authorization.json (grep for finalize_decision|authorize_experiment over PROCEDURE.md returns 0 hits), although R01 required_revision explicitly demanded documentation of the compile/finalize/authorize/clean-deploy/run/analysis handoffs. run-remote.sh:82 refuses to start without the local authorization file, so a cold reader literal-following the procedure stalls at section 3. The tools do exist and are discoverable at repo level (CODE/work/finalize_decision.py; CODE/experiment_platform/authorize_experiment.py:547-552 with --experiment/--finalization/--out; AGENTS.md formal chain; EXPERIMENTS/contracts/run-artifact-contract.md), so this is a documentation-completeness defect of the hash-bound procedure, not a platform impossibility.
